articles.title: Amy Goodman Documentary ‘Steal This Story, Please!’ Acquired by Music Box in North America, Home Entertainment Release Set for Oct. 20 (EXCLUSIVE)

The film, which was initially self-distributed, is set to be released across major digital platforms on October 20. This strategic acquisition is poised to significantly broaden the documentary's reach and accessibility to audiences throughout North America.

articles.title: Annual 350-km canoe trek reconciles First Nations generations a stroke at a time
articles.summary: The Mamu Nikantetau Expedition is an annual 10-day, 350-km canoe/walking trek between Ottawa and Montreal. It aims to foster reconciliation and reconnection among Indigenous elders and youth. This Canadian initiative promotes cultural understanding and intergenerational dialogue, highlighting efforts towards national unity and community building through a challenging physical journey.
